method: Linear interpolation in polar angle of two native evaluated wall-face pressures bracketing each specified cylinder vertex (.15,.2) and(.25,.2). Fluent uses face SV_P; OpenFOAM zeroGradient face value is native owner-cell p. rho=1 converts kinematic p numerically to Pa. These are discretized wall-vertex estimates, not exact continuum point pressures.
cycle_mean_method: Trapezoidal integration with linearly interpolated temporal values only at cycle boundaries; all interior trace samples come from actual saved .005s states.

fluent.meaning: Native Fluent face SV_P in gauge Pa; interpolated in polar angle to the specified cylinder vertices.

openfoam.meaning: Native zeroGradient wall face value equals owner-cell kinematic p; rho=1 converts numerically to Pa. This is evaluated FV wall pressure followed by the same angular interpolation, not an exact continuum point measurement.
